environments.name: Ashen Forest
environments.description: Silent moonlit bamboo and pine forest shrouded in pale drifting volcanic ash.

environments.name: Abandoned Village
environments.description: Burning minka settlement consumed by fire, embers rising into a blood-orange twilight.

environments.name: Crimson Dojo
environments.description: Sacred martial dojo with red lacquered pillars, shoji screens, and golden lanterns.

environments.name: Sunken Prison
environments.description: Subterranean catacombs with moss-covered stone vaults, hanging iron gibbets, and cold puddles.

environments.name: Temple of Embers
environments.description: Mountaintop monastery surrounded by blazing ceremonial braziers and magma fissures.

environments.name: Frozen Pass
environments.description: Snowbound mountain ridge battered by blizzard winds beneath jagged icy crags.

environments.name: Azure Fortress
environments.description: Moonlit ninja stronghold surrounded by sapphire paper lanterns and swirling cherry blossoms.

environments.name: Black Market
environments.description: Underground smuggler alleys lit by deep violet lanterns, incense smoke, and relic stalls.

environments.name: Blood Arena
environments.description: Iron-fenced colosseum courtyard stained with crimson sands under a brutal sunset.

environments.name: Shrine of Echoes
environments.description: Fractured ancient sacred shrine with floating torii fragments and glowing ethereal soul wisps.

environments.name: Drowned City
environments.description: Submerged dynasty palace ruins reflecting neon-turquoise waters beneath gentle rainfall.

environments.name: Obsidian Citadel
environments.description: Imperial fortress of the False Shogun forged from black volcanic glass under storm skies.

environments.name: Void Gate
environments.description: Torn fabric of reality revealing the abyss portal pulsating with spectral violet energy.

environments.name: Throne of Shadows
environments.description: The Hollow King's monolith sanctum where living shadows crawl across obsidian pillars.

environments.name: End of Time
environments.description: A shattered plane beyond the world where fractured memory mirrors reflect infinite destinies.

bosses.name: Goro
bosses.title: The Exiled Blade
bosses.combatStyle: Heavy, readable two-handed katana slashes with high guard crushing power.

bosses.name: Kiba
bosses.title: The Blood Hound
bosses.combatStyle: Lean predatory assassin with swift forward rolls and rapid multi-stab flurries.

bosses.name: Master Ren
bosses.title: The Silent Master
bosses.combatStyle: Elderly martial grandmaster utilizing patient stance, counter-attacks, and defensive parries.

bosses.name: Dreadmaw
bosses.title: The Chain Warden
bosses.combatStyle: Towering iron jailer swinging heavy chain scythes for devastating screen-wide control.

bosses.name: Lady Soryu
bosses.title: The Flame Widow
bosses.combatStyle: Relentless aggression with blazing flame-infused thrusts and explosive blade sweeps.

bosses.name: General Raik
bosses.title: The Storm General
bosses.combatStyle: Disciplined military spear techniques, long piercing lunges, and sweeping anti-air vaults.

bosses.name: Shinobi
bosses.title: The Masked Rival
bosses.combatStyle: High acrobatics, wall rebounds, and fluid dual-blade combinations that mirror Kaze's cadence.

bosses.name: Vex
bosses.title: The Phantom Dealer
bosses.combatStyle: Tricky feints, deceptive smoke decoys, and unexpected low sweeping kicks.

bosses.name: Brutus
bosses.title: The Iron Colossus
bosses.combatStyle: Armored juggernaut resisting flinch with heavy overhead cleaves and ground shockwaves.

bosses.name: Akari (Shinobi)
bosses.title: The Lost Sister
bosses.combatStyle: Unmasked younger sister combining agile family martial arts with adaptive shadow evasions.

bosses.name: Nami
bosses.title: The Drowned Oracle
bosses.combatStyle: Flowing delayed strikes with deceptive rhythm, wave-like recovery cancels, and water bursts.

bosses.name: Lord Kurogane
bosses.title: The False Shogun
bosses.combatStyle: Imperious samurai lord with high-speed iaijutsu draws, impenetrable guard, and heavy counter-slashes.

bosses.name: The Hollow Knight
bosses.title: The Sealbreaker
bosses.combatStyle: Supernatural spectral entity unleashing telegraphed void shockwaves and telekinetic blade strikes.

bosses.name: The Hollow King
bosses.title: The Eternal Tyrant
bosses.combatStyle: Two-phase apocalyptic sovereign: royal dominance in Phase 1, berserk shadow tendrils in Phase 2.

bosses.name: Titan
bosses.title: The Ancient Overlord
bosses.combatStyle: Colossal cybernetic warlord wielding the catastrophic Desolator cleaver with unstoppable momentum.

endings.title: True Ronin
endings.desc: Kaze shatters the cursed blade Nightfall, freeing every stolen shadow to the winds and vanishing as a mortal ronin.

endings.title: Eternal Shadow
endings.desc: Kaze claims the Hollow King's throne, absorbing all dark seals to become the immortal Sovereign of Shadows.

endings.title: Broken Seal
endings.desc: Kaze binds his own soul to the rift, permanently sealing the Hollow realm at the cost of his mortal existence.
